snippet.title: Friday Night Funkin' QT mod Showcase
snippet.description:
Too cute to die for!
I highly recommend trying this mod out for yourself before watching this video!

Here's a Friday Night Funkin' mod me and a friend have been working on for quite a while. Despite it being our first mod, I'm proud of how it came out!


Download the mod: https://gamebanana.com/mods/299714
Check out and support the original game: https://ninja-muffin24.itch.io/funkin

Timestamps:
0:00 - Carefree (1st song)
3:28 - Careless (2nd song)
6:27 - Censory-Overload (3rd song) [Spoilers]
12:36 - Terminate (4th song / ending)
13:18 - Termination (bonus song) [Spoilers]
18:39 - Cessation (2nd bonus song) [Spoilers]
